findings.title: The Immediate predecessor label is attached to v12 instead of v13
findings.finding: The subject is component-manifest leftover-join.v14 and adds frozen component-manifest leftover-join.v13 as its direct versioned predecessor. Nevertheless basedOn.predecessorV12.role now opens 'Immediate frozen predecessor', while basedOn.predecessorV13.role opens only 'Frozen predecessor'. purpose makes the mistake explicit by saying 'Restore Immediate on predecessorV12', and predecessorV13.role then claims CLAUDE-CMLJ-V13-A1 is landed. The frozen advisory concerned v13's dependency graph, in which v12 was the direct versioned predecessor. Advancing the speaker to v14 changes that adjacency: v12 remains the current recorded DR-103 predecessor at draft time, but v13 is the immediate versioned predecessor. The repair therefore creates a false lineage label while claiming to land the advisory.
findings.severityReasoning: This is not merely an omitted positive label. A positive custody label is attached to the wrong frozen artifact, producing a false proposition about the subject's lineage. False provenance and lineage labels are MUST-FIX in this lineage.
findings.requiredRepair: In a successor, remove or qualify Immediate on basedOn.predecessorV12.role and attach the immediate-versioned-predecessor label to basedOn.predecessorV13.role. Keep the distinct true statement that v12 is the current recorded DR-103 leftover-join at the draft pin under D-304. Update purpose and the advisory-landing claim consistently; change no digest, currency conclusion, or frozen predecessor.

The artifact's cumulative evidence ledger, however, is byte-for-byte unchanged in membership from v13: lands remains at 17 entries, findingDisposition remains at the same 17 identifiers, neither field contains any of the three existing Claude v13 identifiers, and landsNote records no v14 landing location. This contradicts the explicit landing claims and repeats the landing-ledger integrity class that the artifact itself records under the existing CLAUDE-CMLJ-V11-B2 disposition.
findings.severityReasoning: The subject's declared purpose is to land predecessor-review findings. Omitting every such landing from the fields dedicated to the cumulative landing record makes the artifact's evidence history internally contradictory, not merely terse. The same class was already treated as MUST-FIX in this lineage.
findings.requiredRepair: In a successor, append the already-existing Claude identifiers CLAUDE-CMLJ-V13-B1, CLAUDE-CMLJ-V13-SF1, and CLAUDE-CMLJ-V13-SF2 to lands and findingDisposition with accurate v14 landing paths, and update landsNote.
